Subject: Execution logistics for mutual DPA (next steps)

David —

Thanks for getting the redlines back to us. Legal here (cc Dana) reviewed Redwood's DPA v3.2 and the subprocessor exhibit. We are close, but need to confirm the operational execution path so we can route on our side and avoid a second round of signatures. A few items we need clarified before we drop into DocuSign: 

- Authorised signatory on Redwood side (name + title) who will countersign final copy
- Order of signatures: StapleTech now, Redwood countersign, or parallel signing?
- Any escrow or witness requirement for our procurement team
- Where audit trail and signed PDF will be sent once envelope completes

I attached our internal checklist (DocuSign instructions) and the draft we received. Can you confirm the flow and who will be the signer(s) for Redwood?

Best,
Ellie Park
Senior Procurement Manager
StapleTech

Attachments: StapleTech-Exec-Checklist.pdf (pdf), requested-redlines-summary.docx (docx)

From: david_kim <david_kim@redwood.inference.com>
To: Ellie Park <ellie.park@stapletech.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Dana Ruiz <dana.ruiz@rlegal.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Execution logistics for mutual DPA (next steps)

Ellie —

Thanks, and appreciate the checklist. Short answers up front, then a proposed playbook below.

- Authorised countersigner: Laura Bennett (VP, Legal Ops) will be the signatory for Redwood. If Laura is unavailable, Monica Patel (Head of Sales Ops) is delegated authority for procurement matters up to $1M per delegation matrix.
- Order of signatures: Our preferred path is StapleTech signs first, Redwood countersigns (sequential). We can also enable parallel signing if you need faster turnaround — let us know.
- Escrow/witness: Redwood does not require an escrow; we can add a witness block if StapleTech requires it.
- Audit trail delivery: DocuSign will auto-email signed PDFs to both parties and the envelope audit trail will be stored in our shared GDrive folder linked below. We will also upload the final signed copy to the HubSpot deal record.

Proposed execution playbook (single message we can convert to envelope notes):
1) StapleTech initiates the envelope with primary signature fields for their two signers (Marcus + Ellie).
2) Routing step: Once StapleTech completes, envelope routes to Laura Bennett (laura_bennett@redwood.inference.com) to countersign.
3) If Laura does not act within 48 hours, fallback route to Monica Patel.
4) Post-execution: DocuSign notifications to both legal contacts + upload to GDrive + attach to HubSpot deal.
5) Audit trail: include envelope history + IP timestamps; we will also export the DocuSign certificate and provide a signed receipt to your procurement team.

Action required from StapleTech: confirm whether you will initiate the envelope or prefer Redwood to initiate (for us to pre-populate metadata and enforce fallback routing). Also confirm if you need witness field added.

I will loop in Laura for signatory confirmation.

Thanks,
David Kim
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: None

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference.com>
To: david_kim <david_kim@redwood.inference.com>, Ellie Park <ellie.park@stapletech.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Dana Ruiz <dana.ruiz@rlegal.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Execution logistics for mutual DPA (next steps)

Quick operational notes from Sales Ops: 

- If Redwood initiates, we'll set envelope pre-fill: deal id RDW-DEAL-2027-0813, contract type = DPA v3.2, contact fields (Ellie, Marcus). That lets us auto-link on completion.
- Fallback routing: set delayed routing rule = 48h -> Monica if Laura doesn't sign. In DocuSign that is the "resend on timeout" route; we'll set reminder at 24h and escalations at 36h.
- Signatory verification: Laura will sign with company cert; Monica will need to attach the delegation approval email when countersigning on behalf of Laura. Please add a required attachment field for delegation evidence in the envelope for the fallback path.
- Subprocessor exhibit: include as separate attachment and tag acknowledgement checkbox for both parties. We prefer a checkbox "I acknowledge the subprocessor list" to avoid future disputes.

I'll spin up the envelope template and can either: (A) send to StapleTech now so you sign and route to Laura, or (B) save as template and let you (Ellie) initiate to start from your side. Recommend (A) to keep fields consistent.

--Monica
Monica Patel
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: DocuSign-Instructions.pdf (pdf)

From: Marcus Holden <m.holden@stapletech.com>
To: david_kim <david_kim@redwood.inference.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Ellie Park <ellie.park@stapletech.com>, Dana Ruiz <dana.ruiz@rlegal.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Execution logistics for mutual DPA (next steps)

Thanks for the clear plan. We prefer StapleTech to initiate (so our procurement metadata flows into our systems), but we have two requests before we start the envelope: 

1) Can Redwood add the required delegation-attachment field for the fallback signer as you described? We'll need that present so our procurement policy is satisfied.
2) Please confirm the envelope recipients and the exact emails we should include for the final audit delivery (we need the signed PDF + certificate go to legal@stapletech.com and to laura_bennett@redwood.inference.com).

If you can confirm those two items we will initiate the envelope from our DocuSign instance today. Expect the envelope id to be shared (we will paste the DocuSign URL in this thread once created).

On a related note, Dana (cc) asked whether Redwood stores the signed artifact in an encrypted bucket and whether retention defaults to 7 years — happy to coordinate the compliance steps after signature.

Cheers,
Marcus Holden
Director, Procurement
StapleTech
